Construct a ccn/ccnr object

Source: R/ccn.R, R/index.R
vctrs.Rd

Construct a ccn/ccnr object

Usage

ccn(x = character())

ccnr(
  entity = character(),
  ccn = character(),
  state = character(),
  number = character(),
  type = character()
)

get_index(x)

# S3 method for class 'ccn'
get_index(x, ...)

Arguments

x

<chr> A vector of CCNs.

entity

<chr> vector of ccn entity types

ccn

<chr> vector of ccns

state

<chr> vector of state codes

number

<chr> vector of sequence numbers

type

<chr> vector of facility types

...

description

Value

An S3 vector of class <ccn> or <ccnr>

Examples

x = get_pin("ccn")
y = ccn(x)
get_index(y)
#> <ccn_index[54567]>
#>     Supplier :  5488
#> Medicaid_Ext :     1
#> Medicare_Ext :   327
#>     Unit_Ext :    14
#>    Emergency :   166
#>     Medicare : 45249
#>        Organ :    55
#>      Subunit :    49
#>         Unit :  3218
z = as_ccnr(x)

vctrs::vec_c(x[1:5], y[100:150], x[1:50], z[100:150])
